new_breakage_in_fix_diff.title: Closing after reload timeout is unbounded and can also block a borrowed debugger session
new_breakage_in_fix_diff.evidence: document-network-capture.ts:73-80 awaits Page.removeScriptToEvaluateOnNewDocument, Runtime.evaluate, and Runtime.removeBinding in series before release. cdp/client.ts:320-327 preserves borrowed attachment on release, but release is never reached if one prior command stalls. For an owned attachment, :344 awaits debugger.detach without a deadline. Cleanup errors are reported only after those awaits settle.
new_breakage_in_fix_diff.remedy: Bound the caller's terminal result independently of cleanup; keep late cleanup attempts and attachment ownership correct. Exercise never-settling cleanup sends and detach with both owned and borrowed sessions.
